regions.today: It will be warm and dry this evening with long spells of sunshine, turning hazy at times, in a light or moderate south to southeasterly breeze.
regions.tonight: There will be a mix of clear spells and well scattered light showers tonight. A few mist and fog patches will develop as the night progresses. It will be mild and muggy, with lowest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in mostly light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Wednesday, will be warm and humid with sunny spells and well scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 23 to 28 degrees in a light to moderate southerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Wednesday and Thursday.
